extra.final_summary: Average bill length (mm) for Adelie penguins by island (21 Adelie rows used after cleaning): Biscoe = 38.375, Dream = 39.3857, Torgersen = 39.1333. Data problems found and fixed: (1) species label variants — " Adelie" (row 1) and "Chinstarp" (row 46) were merged into the allowed labels Adelie/Chinstrap per the rules file, which mattered because row 1 is an Adelie needed for this question; (2) one exact duplicate row (row 28) was removed. bill_length_mm was verified clean (numeric, no negatives, all within the rules range 30–60) and island had no variants. Caveats: flipper_length_mm has 3 negative values and body_mass_g has an out-of-range value (3,500,000 g), but those columns are not used by this question, so they were left untouched; sex has 1 missing value, which the rules say means unknown and should not be guessed.
